title: GIG-3345: Stop Killing Hydra MySQL Restore At Three Hours
description: Removes the Symfony process timeout on MySQL dump restore, adds compress and session speed flags, and reports restore progress so Hydra produce is not killed at an arbitrary hour.

test_plan.description: Hydra restore is not killed at 3 hours
steps: After release, dispatch Hydra produce and confirm restore logs percent progress and is still running after 181 minutes if it has not finished

test_plan.description: Failed restore does not claim 100% and PHPStan is clean
steps: Run composer phpstan and confirm no errors for MysqlRestorer or MysqlRestorerTest
Confirm a successful restore still logs Loading dump into scratch 100%
